adjacency_data = pd.read_csv('chunks_csv/borough_adjacency.csv')

# Compute borough-level crime rates
crime_data['crime_rate'] = crime_data['Crime_value'] / crime_data['population']

# Load the adjacency data
adjacency_data = pd.read_csv('chunks_csv/borough_adjacency.csv')

# Compute neighborhood crime rates
neighborhood_crime_rates = {}
for index, row in crime_data.iterrows():
    neighbors = adjacency_data[adjacency_data['borough'] == row['borough']]
    neighbor_crime_rates = []
    for neighbor in neighbors['neighbor']:
        neighbor_crime_rate = crime_data[crime_data['borough'] == neighbor]['crime_rate'].mean()
        neighbor_crime_rates.append(neighbor_crime_rate)
    neighborhood_crime_rates[row['borough']] = np.mean(neighbor_crime_rates)

# Identify hot spots
hot_spots = []
for index, row in crime_data.iterrows():
    if row['crime_rate'] > neighborhood_crime_rates[row['borough']] and row['crime_rate'] > np.percentile(crime_data['crime_rate'], 75):

    shuffles = np.random.choice(data, size=(n_shuffles, len(data)), replace=True)
